catalysts.headline: Twist Bioscience reported fiscal Q4/full-year 2026 results: FY2026 revenue $459.4M (+22% yoy, beating initial guidance by >$30M); Q4 revenue $126.6M (+27.9% yoy); Q4 adjusted EBITDA $2.2M, the company's first positive quarter on that basis; Q4 gross margin 53.1% vs 51.3% a year earlier. Issued FY2027 guidance of $550-560M revenue (+21% yoy at midpoint, ~$100M expected from AI drug-discovery customers) and Q1 FY2027 guidance of $130-132M (+26% yoy); FY2027 gross margin guided to 52.5-53%, capex expected to rise to ~$75M. Cash stood at ~$582M after ~$425M of equity/ATM raises during the year.
catalysts.impact: Full-year growth and first EBITDA-positive quarter, but FY2027 guidance (+21%) implies deceleration from the 28% Q4 exit growth rate; one report noted shares fell on the day despite the beat, though the magnitude is not consistently reported across sources.

catalysts.headline: Reported fiscal Q4 2026 results: record quarterly revenue $126.6M (+28% YoY), above $123-124M guidance; FY2026 revenue $459.4M (+22% YoY), gross margin 52.4% (Q4 gross margin 53.1% vs 51.3% a year earlier); GAAP net loss narrowed to $20.6M (-$0.32/diluted share) from $27.1M (-$0.45/share) in Q4 FY2025; positive adjusted EBITDA of $2.2M in Q4, vs a loss of $7.8M a year earlier, hitting the company's breakeven target. Guided FY2027 revenue to $550M-$560M and Q1 FY2027 revenue to $130M-$132M.
